rows.nicu_grouping_rules: Sick-newborn DRGs group only with matching NICU revenue codes; otherwise normal newborn rules apply.
rows.level_of_care_support: Requires clinical support for Level IV NICU/extreme prematurity and matching newborn inpatient revenue codes.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Level IV neonatal intensive care includes extreme prematurity and the highest-acuity neonatal inpatient setting.

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: In the DRG program, allow newborn/NICU inpatient grouping only when revenue codes 0170, 0171, 0172, 0173, or 0174 are on the same claim and the revenue code must match DRG; do not apply this edit in Maine, New York, Massachusetts, or Virginia, where Section I does not apply (Virginia due to delayed implementation). Exempt: Section I does not apply in Maine, Section I does not apply in New York, Section I does not apply in Massachusetts, Section I does not apply in Virginia.
